caption: The drawing depicts a doll with a round, beige face featuring simple, symmetrical facial features in muted brown and gray tones, including two small eyes, straight-lined eyebrows, a triangular nose, and a small, slightly pursed mouth. The doll wears a light brown headscarf that covers the head and is tied under the chin. Draped over the doll's shoulders is a brown fringed shawl with parallel lines, arranged over a voluminous, ankle-length dress. The dress is light gray with a repeating pattern of meandering red lines and small dots. Two visible legs extend below the dress, both straight and colored a pale wood-like beige with darker tips. The background is plain and light-colored, and the drawing includes the name “Bertha Semple” written in thin letters to the lower right of the doll.
title: Wooden Doll
